step: Kilgrave surfaces once more in Jessica's mind, taunting her as she thinks about leaving New York.

st: In a hidden HYDRA lab, List stands with Strucker over Loki's scepter and their enhanced test subjects.
When the Avengers raid the Sokovia base, List tries to wipe HYDRA's files, and Iron Man kills him.

entry.k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. STRIKE agent serving HYDRA
st: In 2012, Rollins rides an elevator with Steve and the STRIKE team, and Steve talks his way out with the scepter.
Rollins and Rumlow's STRIKE team jump Steve in a Triskelion elevator, and Steve fights his way out.

entry.k: An eccentric hoarder of rare cosmic relics
st: Sif and Volstagg leave the Aether with the Collector, who means to gather the other stones.
The Collector buys the Orb, and its stone blasts his museum apart when his servant Carina grabs it.
On Knowhere, Thanos, already holding the Reality Stone, traps Gamora with an illusion of the Collector's museum.
Att-Lass and Bron-Char fight Skrulls with Starforce, then hunt Carol on Earth, where her full power overwhelms them.

entry.k: A tentacled beast that feeds on batteries
st: Hired by the Sovereign, the Guardians fight the Abilisk, and Gamora cuts it open through a wound in its neck.
Luchkov has Natasha tied to a chair for questioning, and she breaks free and beats him and his men.
In a vision Wanda gives Natasha, Madame B. trains young Natasha in the Red Room up to her graduation.
M'Baku challenges T'Challa for the throne at Warrior Falls, and yields when T'Challa spares him.
M'Baku shelters the wounded T'Challa and leads the Jabari into battle against Killmonger.

entry.k: A Wakandan prince undercover in Oakland
st: In 1992, N'Jobu helps Klaue steal vibranium, and King T'Chaka kills him when he draws a gun on Zuri.
Linda helps Killmonger and Klaue rob a London museum, and Killmonger shoots her when Klaue uses her as a shield.

entry.k: A small-time criminal shopping for weapons
st: Davis tries to buy alien-tech weapons, and Spider-Man webs him to his car to learn where the next deal is.
Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk wrestles it off the Rainbow Bridge into the sea.
Topaz enforces the Grandmaster's rule on Sakaar and leads the hunt for Thor and Valkyrie.

entry.k: A Red Room scientist and former spy
st: Melina, now working for Dreykov, signals the Red Room when Natasha, Yelena and Alexei reach her farm.
Inside the Red Room, Melina turns on Dreykov and helps the sisters bring it down.
Under Dreykov's chemical control, the Widows hunt Natasha and Yelena for the Red Room.
Natasha releases the antidote and frees the Widows, and they leave with Yelena to free others.
Ronin tears through Akihiko's crew in rainy Tokyo and kills him with a sword.
Uzman helps Burch go after Hank's lab, and police arrest him along with Burch.
In flashbacks, Bill Fisk beats his wife, and young Wilson kills him with a hammer.

entry.k: A trigger-happy thug in Cottonmouth's crew
st: Tone shoots up Pop's barbershop chasing Chico, and Cottonmouth throws him off a roof for it.

entry.k: A Dominican gang boss in Harlem
st: Domingo deals guns in Harlem and clashes with Cottonmouth's crew.
Domingo storms Diamondback's warehouse, and Diamondback crushes him with his gauntlet, leaving him to die.

entry.k: Shades's old friend from Seagate prison
st: Comanche joins Mariah's crew while secretly informing for the police, and Shades kills him.
Zhou Cheng guards the Hand's heroin operation in China, and Danny beats him until Claire makes him stop.
In Gao's duel, Danny beats her fighters one by one: the Veznikov brothers, the Bride of Nine Spiders and Scythe.

entry.k: Harold Meachum's son, running Rand Enterprises
st: Ward has Danny locked in a psychiatric ward to keep him away from Rand Enterprises.
Ward turns on his father and the Hand, and shoots Harold dead to save Danny.
Wolf, tied to Rawlins's heroin smuggling, is killed by Frank in his own home.

entry.k: A lifer inmate in Fisk's pay
st: On Fisk's orders, inmate Jasper Evans stabs him, which gets Fisk moved out of prison.
Evans is brought to the Bulletin to testify, and Dex kills him there before he can.
